title: Clinton and the ALH 84001 meteorite as slow-drip disclosure

tellings.quote: Like, there was already a meteor meteorite in the '90s that, you know, Clinton came out with ALH 84001

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a meteorite from Mars called ALH 84001, which he says President Bill Clinton spoke about publicly in the 1990s. Michels frames it as an early step in a slow, gradual release of evidence that life exists beyond Earth, the kind of drip-by-drip reveal some people call "disclosure".
